exposure: dilatation and curettage (D&C) associated with ectopic pregnancy

D&C for retained placenta with vascularity
D&C for suspected gestational trophoblastic disease
cohort: 29 female patients who underwent prophylactic UAE before obstetrical procedures with high risk for massive bleeding
finding: Prophylactic UAE before obstetrical procedures in patients with high risk of bleeding was found to be safe and effective in preventing serious bleeding, and did not appear to negatively impact future fertility.
